f2d22f31d0.en: IJCAI 2025 — 34th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
f2d22f31d0.zh: IJCAI 2025 — 第 34 届国际人工智能联合会议

e1faf12e46.en: A read of IJCAI 2025 through a trust lens: from AI safety and interpretable reasoning to robust, fair, and hallucination-resistant models — the ingredients of AI people can actually rely on.
e1faf12e46.zh: 从信任的视角解读 IJCAI 2025：从 AI 安全、可解释推理，到鲁棒、公平、抗幻觉的模型 — 这些是人们真正能依赖的 AI 的要素。

02e00deb7c.zh: 主题{1}可信与可解释 AI{/1}

e7d3111fa2.zh: B · 可解释性与鲁棒性

0bbbe51a3f.zh: C · 可信且公平的 LLM / MLLM

d89b139854.en: 34th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence — Montreal, Canada, August 16–22, 2025
d89b139854.zh: 第 34 届国际人工智能联合会议 — 加拿大蒙特利尔，2025 年 8 月 16–22 日

ea01f6e07a.en: {1}Also:{/1} One of the top AI conferences (alongside ICML, AAAI, NeurIPS). Highlights included keynotes by Yoshua Bengio (AI safety) and Rina Dechter (Research Excellence Award).
ea01f6e07a.zh: {1}另外：{/1}它是顶级 AI 会议之一（与 ICML、AAAI、NeurIPS 并列）。亮点包括 Yoshua Bengio（AI 安全）和 Rina Dechter（研究卓越奖）的主旨报告。

012d75fb48.en: Threads across the program: AI safety and governance; explainable, interpretable reasoning (ILP, graphical models); robustness for embodied AI; and trustworthy, fair alignment of LLMs and multimodal models.
012d75fb48.zh: 整个日程的主线：AI 安全与治理；可解释、可理解的推理（ILP、图模型）；具身 AI 的鲁棒性；以及大语言模型和多模态模型的可信、公平对齐。

7ea8f9792b.en: AI Safety: Risks of General-Purpose AI (Keynote)
7ea8f9792b.zh: AI Safety: Risks of General-Purpose AI (Keynote)

e8d7d45f3b.en: Map what general-purpose AI can do, the risks it brings, and the techniques that mitigate them.
e8d7d45f3b.zh: 梳理通用 AI 能做什么、带来哪些风险，以及缓解这些风险的技术。

b5484ad5ca.en: Capable, general models bring severe risks — loss of human control, decentralized misuse, and concentration of power.
b5484ad5ca.zh: 能力强的通用模型带来严重风险 — 失去人类控制、去中心化的滥用以及权力集中。

3df32f6470.en: Synthesize evidence from ~100 experts across 30 countries (+ EU / UN / OECD)
3df32f6470.zh: 综合来自 30 个国家约 100 位专家（以及欧盟 / 联合国 / 经合组织）的证据

1e49155308.en: Classify risks by source: misuse, human imitation, RL side-goals, reward hacking, self-preservation
1e49155308.zh: 按来源对风险分类：滥用、模仿人类、强化学习的附带目标、奖励作弊、自我保存

15f6c06940.en: Set safety requirements, e.g. never assert a false claim with confidence
15f6c06940.zh: 设定安全要求，例如绝不自信地断言虚假说法

094ce55116.en: A shared, international evidence base for AI risk — not a single lab's opinion.
094ce55116.zh: 为 AI 风险提供共享的国际证据基础 — 而不是单个实验室的意见。

23b1bb8f63.en: A common reference for governance and safe-deployment decisions as adoption rises.
23b1bb8f63.zh: 随着应用增长，为治理和安全部署决策提供共同参照。

a2c787e8c5.en: The International AI Safety Report — the backdrop for Bengio's keynote on risks and mitigations.
a2c787e8c5.zh: 国际 AI 安全报告 — Bengio 关于风险与缓解的主旨报告的背景。

42ed25a901.en: Graphical Models Meet Heuristic Search (Keynote){1} — Research Excellence Award{/1}
42ed25a901.zh: Graphical Models Meet Heuristic Search (Keynote){1} — 研究卓越奖{/1}

8a484fe888.en: Solve hard reasoning and inference by combining probabilistic graphical models with heuristic search.
8a484fe888.zh: 把概率图模型与启发式搜索结合，求解困难的推理与推断问题。

f39a2449da.en: Generic solvers struggle on very hard inference; pure search ignores the problem's structure.
f39a2449da.zh: 通用求解器在极难的推断上表现吃力；纯搜索又忽略问题的结构。

a7cbaee526.en: Find ‘tractable islands’ — subproblems you can solve exactly or efficiently
a7cbaee526.zh: 找出“易处理孤岛” — 可以精确或高效求解的子问题

f9f4bd3a21.en: Use them as heuristics to guide search and Monte-Carlo sampling
f9f4bd3a21.zh: 把它们作为启发式，引导搜索和蒙特卡洛采样

7b11e18a33.en: Run anytime: a feasible result early, refined toward exact given more time
7b11e18a33.zh: 以随时算法方式运行：早期就给出可行结果，时间越多越接近精确解

e961229d68.en: The tractable-islands paradigm unifies exact inference, search, bounding and sampling.
e961229d68.zh: 易处理孤岛范式统一了精确推断、搜索、界限估计和采样。

bdfd327218.en: Anytime solvers with guaranteed bounds — valuable when time or compute is limited.
bdfd327218.zh: 带有保证界限的随时求解器 — 在时间或算力有限时很有价值。

16bf311c9c.en: From searching to sampling — tractable ‘islands’ guide both heuristic search and Monte-Carlo sampling.
16bf311c9c.zh: 从搜索到采样 — 易处理“孤岛”同时引导启发式搜索和蒙特卡洛采样。

9adf07dfde.en: Bucket / mini-bucket style reasoning over a graphical model.
9adf07dfde.zh: 在图模型上进行 bucket / mini-bucket 式推理。

c20e108347.en: {1}Dany Varghese et al.{/1} · University of Surrey, UK
c20e108347.zh: {1}Dany Varghese et al.{/1} · University of Surrey, UK

e1f5fd653d.en: Test whether Inductive Logic Programming can match black-box ML while staying interpretable.
e1f5fd653d.zh: 检验归纳逻辑编程能否在保持可解释的同时，达到黑盒机器学习的水平。

aaa19cb4ce.en: Medical AI is often accurate but a black box, which limits transparency and clinician trust.
aaa19cb4ce.zh: 医疗 AI 往往准确但是黑盒，这限制了透明度和临床医生的信任。

90eaf1381a.en: Learn symbolic if-then rules with the PyGol ILP system
90eaf1381a.zh: 用 PyGol ILP 系统学习符号化的 if-then 规则

5d181ceb8a.en: Use Cleveland Heart Disease data (13 features, 303 patients) + medical background knowledge
5d181ceb8a.zh: 使用 Cleveland Heart Disease 数据（13 个特征，303 名患者）+ 医学背景知识

a8d07569cb.en: Compare accuracy and global interpretability against standard ML
a8d07569cb.zh: 与标准机器学习比较准确率和全局可解释性

da043c7d49.en: Rule models reach comparable accuracy and align with real clinical logic — explainable by design.
da043c7d49.zh: 规则模型达到相当的准确率，并与真实临床逻辑一致 — 天生可解释。

e9bfc61c40.en: For clinical adoption, transparent rules can matter more than marginal accuracy; points to neuro-symbolic hybrids.
e9bfc61c40.zh: 对临床应用而言，透明的规则可能比微小的准确率提升更重要；这指向神经符号混合方法。

e92cfd07d1.en: Performance vs. explainability — ILP rule models match ML accuracy while staying interpretable.
e92cfd07d1.zh: 性能与可解释性 — ILP 规则模型在保持可解释的同时，准确率与机器学习相当。

4707b3004f.en: Robust Compression Boundary for Embodied AI{1} — Outstanding Paper{/1}
4707b3004f.zh: Robust Compression Boundary for Embodied AI{1} — 杰出论文{/1}

12babd062d.en: Compress embodied-AI models while keeping accuracy, efficiency AND robustness at once.
12babd062d.zh: 压缩具身 AI 模型，同时兼顾准确率、效率和鲁棒性。

403dba4757.en: On-device robots and vehicles need small, fast models that stay robust to real-world corruptions (noise, blur, weather).
403dba4757.zh: 端侧机器人和车辆需要小而快的模型，并且在面对真实世界的干扰（噪声、模糊、天气）时保持鲁棒。

9b896f0d89.en: Characterize the ‘robust compression boundary’ — how far you can prune/quantize before robustness drops
9b896f0d89.zh: 刻画“鲁棒压缩边界” — 在鲁棒性下降之前，剪枝/量化可以做到多大程度

a85483c7af.en: Fold robustness constraints into the compression objective
a85483c7af.zh: 把鲁棒性约束融入压缩目标

e713ab0946.en: Evaluate on embodied vision/robotics tasks vs accuracy-only baselines
e713ab0946.zh: 在具身视觉/机器人任务上，与只看准确率的基线比较评估

1e5a6b1ea1.en: Treats robustness as a third axis alongside accuracy and efficiency, jointly optimized.
1e5a6b1ea1.zh: 把鲁棒性作为与准确率、效率并列的第三个维度，进行联合优化。

7105f5c365.en: Lower memory/latency deployment on constrained platforms without losing robustness.
7105f5c365.zh: 在受限平台上以更低的内存/延迟部署，同时不损失鲁棒性。

d648cb079b.en: The robust compression boundary — how far a model compresses before robustness to corruptions drops.
d648cb079b.zh: 鲁棒压缩边界 — 模型压缩到什么程度，对干扰的鲁棒性会开始下降。

f8ded63b61.en: {1}Guoliang Dong et al.{/1} · SMU & Zhejiang University
f8ded63b61.zh: {1}Guoliang Dong et al.{/1} · SMU & Zhejiang University

cb31a5eac7.en: Measure and reduce how an LLM's safety and quality vary across languages.
cb31a5eac7.zh: 衡量并减少大语言模型的安全性和质量在不同语言之间的差异。

e984ec07d4.en: LLMs answer the same question differently by language — a safety- and knowledge-equity gap.
e984ec07d4.zh: 大语言模型对同一个问题会因语言不同而给出不同回答 — 这是安全与知识公平方面的差距。

ad82d5abf0.en: Use metamorphic testing: same-meaning inputs in different languages should give same-meaning outputs
ad82d5abf0.zh: 使用蜕变测试：不同语言中含义相同的输入，应给出含义相同的输出

ae456cb2b9.en: At inference, translate a query into k languages and answer each, then translate back
ae456cb2b9.zh: 推理时，把查询翻译成 k 种语言并分别回答，再翻译回来

75bcee7db3.en: Pick the reply most consistent with the others by cosine similarity (voting)
75bcee7db3.zh: 按余弦相似度选出与其他回答最一致的回复（投票）

23201b8259.en: A translate-answer-vote wrapper that improves safety and quality with no retraining.
23201b8259.zh: 一个“翻译-回答-投票”的封装，无需重新训练即可提升安全性和质量。

17d338f98e.en: Lower jailbreak rates and higher F1 across languages — fairer, safer multilingual deployment.
17d338f98e.zh: 各语言下越狱率更低、F1 更高 — 更公平、更安全的多语言部署。

4fb9f28dfd.en: An LLM's answers differ across languages — the inequity this work measures and mitigates.
4fb9f28dfd.zh: 大语言模型的回答因语言而异 — 这正是本工作要衡量并缓解的不公平。

071554d12c.en: Translate to k languages, answer each, translate back, then vote for the most consistent reply.
071554d12c.zh: 翻译成 k 种语言，分别回答，再翻译回来，然后投票选出最一致的回复。

ab342cf544.en: {1}Songtao Jiang et al.{/1} · Zhejiang University & NUS
ab342cf544.zh: {1}Songtao Jiang et al.{/1} · Zhejiang University & NUS

e5f8b5d175.en: Make multimodal LLMs rely fairly on both the image and the text.
e5f8b5d175.zh: 让多模态大语言模型公平地依赖图像和文本两者。

7e57136165.en: MLLMs often lean on text and under-use the image, which hurts trustworthiness.
7e57136165.zh: MLLM 常常偏重文本而对图像利用不足，这损害了可信度。

c11bce4fb8.en: Perturb key image regions (text fixed) to build chosen vs rejected image pairs
c11bce4fb8.zh: 扰动关键图像区域（文本不变），构建被选中与被拒绝的图像对

4a8819ee29.en: Train a modality-fair loss aligning text and image preferences with a stability margin
4a8819ee29.zh: 训练模态公平损失，用稳定性边距对齐文本和图像偏好

2aa2e056fc.en: Use keyword-guided region selection and easy-to-hard iterative training
2aa2e056fc.zh: 采用关键词引导的区域选择和由易到难的迭代训练

c0598867a6.en: Balances preference alignment across modalities rather than text-only DPO.
c0598867a6.zh: 在各模态间平衡偏好对齐，而不是只针对文本的 DPO。

56cb5bf8f7.zh: 多模态回答的依据更扎实、更可信。

8da12c4a7e.en: Modality-fair preference optimization — perturb key image regions to build chosen / rejected pairs.
8da12c4a7e.zh: 模态公平偏好优化 — 扰动关键图像区域，构建被选中 / 被拒绝的图像对。

3e298aa064.en: Token-Level Accept or Reject: Micro Alignment
3e298aa064.zh: Token-Level Accept or Reject: Micro Alignment

8956c12659.en: {1}Yang Zhang et al.{/1} · Hong Kong Polytechnic University
8956c12659.zh: {1}Yang Zhang et al.{/1} · Hong Kong Polytechnic University

6093d1c410.en: Align an LLM without fine-tuning it — accept or reject each candidate token with a tiny model.
6093d1c410.zh: 无需微调即可对齐大语言模型 — 用一个很小的模型接受或拒绝每个候选 token。

af570786c3.en: RLHF/DPO fine-tune billions of parameters (costly) and align at the sentence level (coarse).
af570786c3.zh: RLHF/DPO 要微调数十亿参数（成本高），且在句子层面对齐（粒度粗）。

7326a2939f.en: Keep the LLM frozen; a small 3-layer accept/reject model filters each candidate token
7326a2939f.zh: 保持大语言模型冻结；由一个 3 层的小型接受/拒绝模型过滤每个候选 token

3e4613d564.en: Frame it as an MDP (accept/reject) with an alignment + divergence reward
3e4613d564.zh: 将其建模为 MDP（接受/拒绝），奖励包含对齐项和散度项

504cc31d95.en: Use top-k/top-p truncation for speed, with a fallback if all tokens are rejected
504cc31d95.zh: 用 top-k/top-p 截断提速，并在所有 token 都被拒绝时提供回退方案

62c2c87e0b.en: Moves alignment from full fine-tuning to a lightweight, token-granular controller.
62c2c87e0b.zh: 把对齐从完整微调转为轻量的、token 粒度的控制器。

4ee77c861e.en: Much cheaper, more controllable alignment that retains or improves quality.
4ee77c861e.zh: 成本低得多、更可控的对齐，同时保持或提升质量。

559adc1a4a.en: A small accept/reject model filters candidate tokens after the frozen LLM.
559adc1a4a.zh: 一个小型接受/拒绝模型在冻结的大语言模型之后过滤候选 token。

4cda4653da.en: {1}Jisheng Dang et al.{/1} · Lanzhou Univ., SYSU, NUS, HKU
4cda4653da.zh: {1}Jisheng Dang et al.{/1} · Lanzhou Univ., SYSU, NUS, HKU

76aa8d0c13.en: Improve semantic alignment between video and text to cut hallucinations.
76aa8d0c13.zh: 改善视频与文本之间的语义对齐，以减少幻觉。

d6a41fbd25.en: Video-language models hallucinate when visual and language semantics are poorly aligned.
d6a41fbd25.zh: 当视觉与语言语义对齐不佳时，视频语言模型会产生幻觉。

f607fb4e29.en: Add a contrastive loss matching correct video-text pairs and separating mismatches
f607fb4e29.zh: 加入对比损失，匹配正确的视频-文本对并分开不匹配的对

389dc89ed5.en: Two-stage training: broad video-language pre-training, then task fine-tuning
389dc89ed5.zh: 两阶段训练：先进行广泛的视频语言预训练，再进行任务微调

630052cafd.en: Inject text-semantic supervision into the visual Q-Former
630052cafd.zh: 向视觉 Q-Former 注入文本语义监督

89bfe4f894.en: Hierarchical multimodal consistency makes visual features more semantically discriminative.
89bfe4f894.zh: 分层多模态一致性使视觉特征在语义上更具区分度。

842d799179.en: Fewer hallucinations and better video understanding for captioning and QA.
842d799179.zh: 幻觉更少，视频理解更好，适用于字幕生成和问答。

e880f7c625.en: Hierarchical multimodal consistency — align video and text to reduce hallucinations.
e880f7c625.zh: 分层多模态一致性 — 对齐视频与文本以减少幻觉。

75a5668120.en: Trustworthy AI is maturing — explainability need not cost accuracy (e.g. ILP rule models).
75a5668120.zh: 可信 AI 正在成熟 — 可解释性不必以牺牲准确率为代价（例如 ILP 规则模型）。

6f00d1c867.en: Robustness is emerging as a third design axis beyond accuracy and efficiency.
6f00d1c867.zh: 鲁棒性正成为准确率和效率之外的第三个设计维度。

88bc8aa21e.en: Lightweight alignment and fairness (token-level, modality-fair) work without full retraining.
88bc8aa21e.zh: 轻量的对齐与公平方法（token 级、模态公平）无需完整重训练即可奏效。

5163e888db.en: A unified trust framework combining symbolic reasoning, probabilistic inference and neural learning.
5163e888db.zh: 一个统一的信任框架，结合符号推理、概率推断和神经学习。

6890b30b03.en: AI agents with long-term memory, reasoning and self-monitoring.
6890b30b03.zh: 具备长期记忆、推理和自我监控的 AI 智能体。

811a94b696.en: More international AI governance around power concentration, bias and misuse.
811a94b696.zh: 围绕权力集中、偏见和滥用，形成更多国际 AI 治理。

34e3cc52a0.en: Embed explainability and transparency modules into products.
34e3cc52a0.zh: 在产品中嵌入可解释性和透明性模块。

6f23d1768e.en: Treat robustness-to-corruption as a first-class metric for embodied / edge AI.
6f23d1768e.zh: 把对干扰的鲁棒性作为具身 / 边缘 AI 的一等指标。

383ee1f14b.en: Adopt cheap alignment (token-level, multilingual voting) for safer deployment.
383ee1f14b.zh: 采用低成本对齐（token 级、多语言投票），实现更安全的部署。

1751bd3d84.zh: 第 34 届国际人工智能联合会议 · 加拿大蒙特利尔 · 2025 年 8 月 16–22 日

7462e98c00.zh: Graphical Models Meet Heuristic Search (Keynote) {1}· 研究卓越奖{/1}

f247b5e34c.zh: 洞察 03 · 可解释性与鲁棒性

13a5afdff6.zh: 洞察 04 · 可解释性与鲁棒性

c9598e5b42.en:
Insights

  • Trustworthy AI is maturing — explainability need not cost accuracy (e.g. ILP rule models).
  • Robustness is emerging as a third design axis beyond accuracy and efficiency.
  • Lightweight alignment and fairness (token-level, modality-fair) work without full retraining.

Vision

  • A unified trust framework combining symbolic reasoning, probabilistic inference and neural learning.
  • AI agents with long-term memory, reasoning and self-monitoring.
  • More international AI governance around power concentration, bias and misuse.

Implications for us

  • Embed explainability and transparency modules into products.
  • Treat robustness-to-corruption as a first-class metric for embodied / edge AI.
  • Adopt cheap alignment (token-level, multilingual voting) for safer deployment.
c9598e5b42.zh:
洞察

  • 可信 AI 正在成熟 — 可解释性不必以牺牲准确率为代价（例如 ILP 规则模型）。
  • 鲁棒性正成为准确率和效率之外的第三个设计维度。
  • 轻量的对齐与公平方法（token 级、模态公平）无需完整重训练即可奏效。

愿景

  • 一个统一的信任框架，结合符号推理、概率推断和神经学习。
  • 具备长期记忆、推理和自我监控的 AI 智能体。
  • 围绕权力集中、偏见和滥用，形成更多国际 AI 治理。

对我们的启示

  • 在产品中嵌入可解释性和透明性模块。
  • 把对干扰的鲁棒性作为具身 / 边缘 AI 的一等指标。
  • 采用低成本对齐（token 级、多语言投票），实现更安全的部署。

2d88807164.zh: 洞察 01 · 安全与推理基础

2be8de6e25.en: Yoshua Bengio (keynote) · International AI Safety Report
2be8de6e25.zh: Yoshua Bengio (keynote) · International AI Safety Report

95d2441d68.en: Synthesize evidence from ~100 experts across 30 countries (+ EU / UN / OECD) · Classify risks by source: misuse, human imitation, RL side-goals, reward hacking, self-preservation · Set safety requirements, e.g. never assert a false claim with confidence
95d2441d68.zh: 综合来自 30 个国家约 100 位专家（以及欧盟 / 联合国 / 经合组织）的证据 · 按来源对风险分类：滥用、模仿人类、强化学习的附带目标、奖励作弊、自我保存 · 设定安全要求，例如绝不自信地断言虚假说法

4fb5787f85.zh: 洞察 02 · 安全与推理基础

b6344eafb6.en: Find ‘tractable islands’ — subproblems you can solve exactly or efficiently · Use them as heuristics to guide search and Monte-Carlo sampling · Run anytime: a feasible result early, refined toward exact given more time
b6344eafb6.zh: 找出“易处理孤岛” — 可以精确或高效求解的子问题 · 把它们作为启发式，引导搜索和蒙特卡洛采样 · 以随时算法方式运行：早期就给出可行结果，时间越多越接近精确解

fcab189d1a.zh: 洞察 03 · 可解释性与鲁棒性

c67fb0a667.en: Dany Varghese et al. · University of Surrey, UK
c67fb0a667.zh: Dany Varghese et al. · University of Surrey, UK

48d644aeee.en: Learn symbolic if-then rules with the PyGol ILP system · Use Cleveland Heart Disease data (13 features, 303 patients) + medical background knowledge · Compare accuracy and global interpretability against standard ML
48d644aeee.zh: 用 PyGol ILP 系统学习符号化的 if-then 规则 · 使用 Cleveland Heart Disease 数据（13 个特征，303 名患者）+ 医学背景知识 · 与标准机器学习比较准确率和全局可解释性

49cc08cf61.zh: 洞察 04 · 可解释性与鲁棒性

711e39b472.en: Chong Yu et al. · Fudan University
711e39b472.zh: Chong Yu et al. · Fudan University

be1041857a.en: Characterize the ‘robust compression boundary’ — how far you can prune/quantize before robustness drops · Fold robustness constraints into the compression objective · Evaluate on embodied vision/robotics tasks vs accuracy-only baselines
be1041857a.zh: 刻画“鲁棒压缩边界” — 在鲁棒性下降之前，剪枝/量化可以做到多大程度 · 把鲁棒性约束融入压缩目标 · 在具身视觉/机器人任务上，与只看准确率的基线比较评估

331148a5c4.zh: 洞察 05 · 可信且公平的 LLM / MLLM

24c34a6de2.en: Guoliang Dong et al. · SMU & Zhejiang University
24c34a6de2.zh: Guoliang Dong et al. · SMU & Zhejiang University

c73c8812b6.en: Use metamorphic testing: same-meaning inputs in different languages should give same-meaning outputs · At inference, translate a query into k languages and answer each, then translate back · Pick the reply most consistent with the others by cosine similarity (voting)
c73c8812b6.zh: 使用蜕变测试：不同语言中含义相同的输入，应给出含义相同的输出 · 推理时，把查询翻译成 k 种语言并分别回答，再翻译回来 · 按余弦相似度选出与其他回答最一致的回复（投票）

c6aa4624ac.zh: 洞察 06 · 可信且公平的 LLM / MLLM

fb9140e73d.en: Songtao Jiang et al. · Zhejiang University & NUS
fb9140e73d.zh: Songtao Jiang et al. · Zhejiang University & NUS

4557fd4f77.en: Perturb key image regions (text fixed) to build chosen vs rejected image pairs · Train a modality-fair loss aligning text and image preferences with a stability margin · Use keyword-guided region selection and easy-to-hard iterative training
4557fd4f77.zh: 扰动关键图像区域（文本不变），构建被选中与被拒绝的图像对 · 训练模态公平损失，用稳定性边距对齐文本和图像偏好 · 采用关键词引导的区域选择和由易到难的迭代训练

63ac1d555b.zh: 洞察 07 · 可信且公平的 LLM / MLLM

09b8d34b81.en: Yang Zhang et al. · Hong Kong Polytechnic University
09b8d34b81.zh: Yang Zhang et al. · Hong Kong Polytechnic University

ec3624143f.en: Keep the LLM frozen; a small 3-layer accept/reject model filters each candidate token · Frame it as an MDP (accept/reject) with an alignment + divergence reward · Use top-k/top-p truncation for speed, with a fallback if all tokens are rejected
ec3624143f.zh: 保持大语言模型冻结；由一个 3 层的小型接受/拒绝模型过滤每个候选 token · 将其建模为 MDP（接受/拒绝），奖励包含对齐项和散度项 · 用 top-k/top-p 截断提速，并在所有 token 都被拒绝时提供回退方案

66fb15c43d.zh: 洞察 08 · 可信且公平的 LLM / MLLM

6a560bb777.en: Jisheng Dang et al. · Lanzhou Univ., SYSU, NUS, HKU
6a560bb777.zh: Jisheng Dang et al. · Lanzhou Univ., SYSU, NUS, HKU

b9d876e086.en: Add a contrastive loss matching correct video-text pairs and separating mismatches · Two-stage training: broad video-language pre-training, then task fine-tuning · Inject text-semantic supervision into the visual Q-Former
b9d876e086.zh: 加入对比损失，匹配正确的视频-文本对并分开不匹配的对 · 两阶段训练：先进行广泛的视频语言预训练，再进行任务微调 · 向视觉 Q-Former 注入文本语义监督
